failures.rootCause: The project opened normally and showed the requested open task, but the task-completion click did not complete successfully.
failures.suggestedFix: Retry the checkbox action while capturing the resulting task-update request and the post-click state; investigate the task completion handler if the task remains open or the update request fails.
